javascript.message: window.__NOTIS_RUNTIME__ is forbidden; rely on the portal-injected NotisProvider runtime.
document.body, document.head, and document.documentElement are forbidden; apps must stay inside the app surface.
React portals are unsupported in Notis apps until a shadow-safe overlay contract exists.
@radix-ui/react-portal is unsupported in Notis apps until a shadow-safe overlay contract exists.
Radix portal primitives are unsupported in Notis apps until a shadow-safe overlay contract exists.

css.message: :root selectors are forbidden; styles must stay inside the app surface.
html selectors are forbidden; styles must stay inside the app surface.
body selectors are forbidden; styles must stay inside the app surface.
portal-owned [data-notis-*] selectors are forbidden. Use [data-notis-app-root] only for the app surface itself.
